decision: Generated documentation includes lattice-compact-list and lattice-compact-item Lit components for compact repeated items that need a name, description, and optional link. Compact lists are intended for dense contexts that would otherwise use lattice-unit-card but do not need a full card frame.
name: Render compact linked item lists
description: Documents the compact list components so generated docs can show dense linked name-and-description rows without full unit cards.
